query: UPDATE webhook_deliveries SET attempts = attempts + 1, last_status_code = $3, status = CASE WHEN $4 THEN 'delivered' WHEN $5::timestamptz IS NULL THEN 'failed' ELSE 'pending' END, next_attempt_at = $5, delivered_at = CASE WHEN $4 THEN $6 ELSE delivered_at END WHERE account_id = $1 AND id = $2
